description: HTML file that provides a demo page for the CodeMirror JavaScript mode, including embedded JavaScript code for StringStream class and CodeMirror initialization.

classes.name: StringStream
classes.description: A class implementing a character stream for JavaScript code syntax highlighting.

methods.name: StringStream.prototype.done
methods.description: Checks if the stream has reached the end of the input string.

methods.name: StringStream.prototype.peek
methods.description: Returns the current character without advancing the position.

methods.name: StringStream.prototype.next
methods.description: Returns the current character and advances the position.

methods.name: StringStream.prototype.eat
methods.description: Consumes the current character if it matches the provided string or pattern.

methods.name: StringStream.prototype.eatWhile
methods.description: Consumes characters while the match condition is true.

methods.name: StringStream.prototype.backUp
methods.description: Moves the current position backwards by n characters.

methods.name: StringStream.prototype.column
methods.description: Returns the current position in the stream.

methods.name: StringStream.prototype.eatSpace
methods.description: Consumes whitespace characters from the current position.

methods.name: StringStream.prototype.match
methods.description: Attempts to match a pattern or string at the current position.
